2607.22355.title: SiPhy: Single-Image Physical Property Reasoning
2607.22355.paper_summary: Inferring physical properties such as mass, stiffness, and elasticity from a single image is essential for simulation and embodied AI, yet most existing approaches rely on multi-view reconstruction or physics-based supervision. We introduce SiPhy, a unified framework for single-image physical property reasoning that aligns 3D-aware visual cues, depth with language-based material knowledge. From one RGB image, SiPhy samples pseudo-voxel points, extracts CLIP features, and grounds them to material candidates proposed by a VLM. A part-based contrastive aggregator enforces region consistency, while a heaviness-aware refinement improves thickness and volume estimation for dense objects. Across ABO-500, MVImgNet-100, and PhysXNet-100, SiPhy achieves state-of-the-art single-image performance, surpassing multi-view reconstruction methods by improving mass MnRE by up to 93% (vs. PUGS), reducing density MAE by 35.5% (vs. NeRF2Physics), and lowering Young's modulus error by 23.5%. We further validate SiPhy on real hand-object interaction datasets, demonstrating its potential as a data annotation engine for physical understanding from single-view imagery.
2607.22355.paper_summary_zh: 從單一圖像推斷物理性質，如質量、剛度和彈性，對於模擬和具身 AI 至關重要，然而大多數現有方法依賴於多視角重建或基於物理的監督。我們介紹 SiPhy，一個統一的單圖像物理性質推理框架，該框架將 3D 感知的視覺線索、深度與基於語言的材料知識對齊。從一張 RGB 圖像中，SiPhy 抽取偽體素點，提取 CLIP 特徵，並將其與 VLM 提出的材料候選進行對接。一個基於部件的對比聚合器強化了區域一致性，而一個重度感知的細化則改善了對於密集物體的厚度和體積估計。在 ABO-500、MVImgNet-100 和 PhysXNet-100 上，SiPhy 實現了最先進的單圖像性能，通過提高質量 MnRE 多達 93%（相較於 PUGS），減少密度 MAE 35.5%（相較於 NeRF2Physics），並降低楊氏模量誤差 23.5%。我們進一步在真實的手-物體互動數據集上驗證了 SiPhy，展示了其作為從單視圖影像中進行物理理解的數據標註引擎的潛力。
